# Core

The everyday records of a company: people, organizations, teams, projects, tasks, events, notes, messages, files and products. Included in every workspace.

Packs are versioned with the standard, currently 0.1.0. Each model below has its own version.

## Models

| Model | Version | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Event](../models/event) | v1 | A scheduled block of time: a meeting, a call, an appointment, a reminder. |
| [File](../models/file) | v1 | Stored or referenced binary content with a name and a type. |
| [Message](../models/message) | v1 | One message on a channel: an email, a chat message, an SMS, a call record, with sender, recipients, body and the records it is about. |
| [Note](../models/note) | v1 | Free text about one or more records: an internal note, a comment, a meeting summary. |
| [Organization](../models/organization) | v1 | A company, nonprofit, government body or household: a customer, a vendor, a partner or an account. |
| [Person](../models/person) | v1 | A human being: a customer, a contact, an employee, or an end user of the product. |
| [Product](../models/product) | v1 | A thing the business sells or buys: a good, a service or a digital item. |
| [Project](../models/project) | v1 | A container of work with a lifecycle: planned, active, paused, done or cancelled. |
| [Task](../models/task) | v1 | A unit of work with a status, a priority, assignees and a due date. |
| [Team](../models/team) | v1 | A named group of Members that work is assigned to. |
